# Agentic Intelligence System — Public Discovery

AIS exposes provider-agnostic capabilities for discovery. Local workstation, routing, model, cost, and repository-policy data remain private to the runtime.

## Capability Registry

### Claude Code
- Capability: Multi-file refactors, TDD loops, library upgrades
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### DeepAgent (dcode)
- Capability: Long-horizon tasks, multi-step planning, remote sandboxing
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Cursor
- Capability: Frontend UI layout, interactive visual edits
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Codex CLI
- Capability: Standard developer tasks, security audits
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### OpenCode
- Capability: Trivial configuration edits, speed-coding, and API testing
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

### Antigravity (agy)
- Capability: High-velocity OS & creator workspace operations, cross-repo sync
- Runtime: Provider-agnostic; selected privately for each task.

## Public Skills

### agent-manager-skill (v1.0.0)
- Description: Orchestrate, route, monitor, and hand off between AI coding agents on this workstation.

### model-routing (v1.0.0)
- Description: Intelligent model selection - routes tasks to Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus based on task complexity analysis.
